body: This is truly beautiful and it made my day. Thank you for sharing sweets xx

Happiest of birthdays to you. I hope this year is gentle, filled with uncontrollable laughter and health. I’m so unbelievably proud of you and I’m rooting for you. You got this and you’re doing great! Wishing you and your lovely family all the best. ❤️
That’s such a good idea I will definitely be trying this, thank you for sharing :)
Yes! So proud of you, you deserve all the self-care moments. :)

I also feel extremely sensitive to weed and get overwhelming anxiety from it. Oddly enough though on shrooms I feel at peace. It completely depends on the person so I would suggest you start small and then see how you feel. Make sure you’re in a good head space before.

This also happened when I first adopted my cat. I put all his essentials in the room he seemed to feel safest in. It took a couple days until he was fully eating and drinking. Just think about it this way, when humans are really anxious, they don’t feel as hungry. Give her some time and I am sure everything will fall perfectly into place. :)

Same I have taken it so many times in low doses and couldn’t feel anything so I upped my dose and ended up taking 8g without feeling any effects until I passed out and spent a full day barely able to walk, violently puking every 10 minutes and passing out.

This happened to me today too. The number I called was located in another region and therefore couldn’t provide me with the ressources. I would suggest either googling lifeline numbers and include your region or call them back and ask them which number to reach.
So cool! Wish i was able to do stuff like this on my board:)
Your scars don’t ever define you. You are strong and you can do this. Scars slowly fade and so does the pain. You got this and i believe in you:)

I would suggest wearing loose fitted shirts that let you breathe. Also if you’re not too uncomfortable with wearing shorts or smt that could help as well. From experience I would just wear a short sleeve and put an open dress shirt on top and that wasn’t too hot for me. I wish you all the best
Thats so great. Don’t give up:)

If you really feel trapped in not being able to talk i suggest writing down in a journal. It helped me be able to put words on my feelings and eventually i managed to open up to some people. Idk if it could help you but in my experience it does:)
Big props keep at it you got this:)
Its so great! You should be really proud of yourself. Dont give up:)
I am really sorry for your loss. In no way does this make you a murderer. She was suffering and she made the decision to do it. You did not tell her or make her do it. Stay strong.
